Features¶

This is a menu system for gms 2.3.1+. The menu system allows you to make a title and pause menu in matter of minutes. It has a bunch of different menu elements like sliders, toggles, credits and shifts (multi option select). It also allows you to make a controls menu with one line of code with my InputSystem.

And you don’t have to worry about anything else than the font and color theme, the system will automatically adjust the size of every element. But if you don’t like something you can change nearly everthing fairly easily.

It also has a built in pause system which allows you to pause any game with one line of code.

The system has automatic saving and loading, even for inputs.
